# Chapter template

Copy everything below the line into the working goals file each new chapter and
fill it in. Keep instructions out of the working file — the full authoring
contract lives in [goal-markdown.md](goal-markdown.md); the two-line memory
jogger is: **you type the bars, the why, and optional obstacles/notes/target —
everything else is inferred and confirmed at ingestion.** Don't touch `gid`
comments on re-ingest.

---

M/D - M/D — "Chapter Theme"

Theme:
<one or two sentences on what this season is about, per person>

Deliberately setting down:
<what's parked on purpose — the bot treats this as chosen, never as slippage>

Things true this season the plans should respect:
* <trips, birthdays, constraints>

### Matthew

* goal title (cadence phrased naturally: daily, 3x/week, every 4 days, 5x by chapter end)
	* need: minimum bar — the 95% floor
	* want: stretch bar (optional; `stretch:`/`min:` also accepted)
	* why: required — one line or several
	* obstacles: optional, verbatim, one per bullet
	* notes: optional logistics/tactics, kept out of the bar
	* target: YYYY-MM-DD (one-offs only — no target means full-list only)

* one-offs (shared why below):
	* discrete item one
	* discrete item two
	* why: one why the bucket shares

rotate: [goal-a, rest, goal-b, rest]   <- only for goals sharing one alternating rhythm
